description: This source file implements network interface enumeration and attribute retrieval for different platforms (macOS, Android, Linux). It includes functions to convert system interface data into internal representations, with platform-specific classes and methods for obtaining IP attributes and interface types.

classes.name: IPAttributesGetterMac
classes.description: Platform-specific class for retrieving IP address attributes and interface types on macOS using ioctl calls.

methods.name: IPAttributesGetterMac
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket for ioctl operations.

methods.description: Destructor closing the socket if initialized.

methods.name: GetAddressAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves IP address attributes via ioctl for a given interface.

methods.name: GetNetworkInterfaceType
methods.description: Determines the network type (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, etc.) for a given interface on macOS.
